description: Reads a business's website page by page (up to 25 pages) and writes its profile (business.md, every line with the page it came from) and its canonical facts (name, logo, colours, tagline, products with prices, claims; each with its page, and held for a yes where pages disagree or a claim has no proof). Returns a job whose result is a business id; read it with ugcfans_get_business. Free of credits.
name: ugcfans_read_business
title: Read a business's website
